lines.say: Good morning. Before the day gets going, hear this.
lines.small: Before the day gets going, hear this.

lines.say: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
lines.big: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

lines.say: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness. Lamentations three, twenty-two and twenty-three.
lines.big: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

lines.say: Whatever yesterday was, his mercy did not run out overnight.
lines.big: His mercy didn't run out overnight.

lines.say: Lord, thank you for new mercy this morning. Walk with me through today. In Jesus' name, amen.
Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.
lines.small: Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day
